\chapter{The First Form Line: Name}
\label{ch:pa-form-name}
\hlchaptermodality{15}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can recognise the Gurmukhi name label, select between two separately practised values, and fill one requested name line from a nonverbal cue with no model.}

The learner fills one name field from a nonverbal identity cue after the label, both values, selection, supported entry, delayed entry, spelling, spacing, and repair have each received a bounded pass.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[a]{\pa{ਅ} — a vowel that can stand first}

\label{lesson:PA-W02-a}



\begin{quote}
Point to the first known piece in \textbf{\pa{ਨਮਸਤੇ}}: \textbf{\pa{ਨ}}. A consonant can carry an unwritten \emph{a}. Today a vowel stands by itself at the beginning of a word.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script}
\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਅ}}
\end{quote}

Read it as short \emph{a}. It is one complete letter, not a mark attached to a consonant. That is why it can begin the practice name in the next lesson.

\subsection*{Writing — observe and trace}
Keep \textbf{\pa{ਅ}} visible. Follow one printed model with your finger, then trace it once. Compare only three things: the top line, the upright, and the lower turn.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Cover the model for two seconds. Point to \textbf{\pa{ਅ}} when it appears beside \textbf{\pa{ਨ}}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[Aman]{\pa{ਅਮਨ} — one new piece, two old pieces}

\label{lesson:PA-W02-aman}



\begin{quote}
Read the three separate pieces: \textbf{\pa{ਅ} · \pa{ਮ} · \pa{ਨ}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — assemble the practice name}
\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਅ}} + \textbf{\pa{ਮ}} + \textbf{\pa{ਨ}} $\to$ \textbf{\pa{ਅਮਨ}}
\end{quote}

This book uses \textbf{\pa{ਅਮਨ}} as one closed-bank practice identity. It is not asking you to spell your own name yet.

\subsection*{Writing — guided copy}
Keep \textbf{\pa{ਅਮਨ}} visible. Copy it once, saying each piece as your hand reaches it. Compare left to right. Repair only the first differing piece.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Point to the only piece that was new today: \textbf{\pa{ਅ}}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[Manan]{\pa{ਮਨਨ} — two familiar pieces, one repeated}

\label{lesson:PA-W02-manan}



\begin{quote}
Write \textbf{\pa{ਮ}} once and \textbf{\pa{ਨ}} once. No new letter appears today.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — assemble the second practice name}
\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਮ}} + \textbf{\pa{ਨ}} + \textbf{\pa{ਨ}} $\to$ \textbf{\pa{ਮਨਨ}}
\end{quote}

This is the second and final value in the first name-field bank. Notice the two adjacent \textbf{\pa{ਨ}} letters; neither may disappear.

\subsection*{Writing — guided copy}
Keep \textbf{\pa{ਮਨਨ}} visible. Copy it once. Tap three positions after writing: \textbf{\pa{ਮ} | \pa{ਨ} | \pa{ਨ}}. If there are only two positions, restore the final \textbf{\pa{ਨ}}.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Contrast once: \textbf{\pa{ਅਮਨ}} begins with \textbf{\pa{ਅ}}; \textbf{\pa{ਮਨਨ}} begins with \textbf{\pa{ਮ}}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[nāṁ]{\pa{ਨਾਂ} — the first form label}

\label{lesson:PA-W02-name-label}



\begin{quote}
Build the known pieces aloud: \textbf{\pa{ਨ} + \pa{ਾ} + \pa{ਂ}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — read the label}
\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਨਾਂ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

On a form, \textbf{\pa{ਨਾਂ}} asks for a name. The colon belongs to the form; it is not a Gurmukhi letter. Point to the label, then point to the empty answer line.

\subsection*{Writing — one label}
Copy \textbf{\pa{ਨਾਂ}} once. Check the base \textbf{\pa{ਨ}}, then the long-vowel mark, then the nasal dot. Do not add a name value yet.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Find \textbf{\pa{ਨਾਂ}} among \textbf{\pa{ਹਾਂ} · \pa{ਨਾਂ} · \pa{ਨਹੀਂ}} without writing the other two words.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[Aman; Manan]{Two people, two already-known values}

\label{lesson:PA-W02-name-select}



\begin{quote}
Read both names. Point to the first differing letter:

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਅਮਨ} · \pa{ਮਨਨ}}
\end{quote}
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — attach one nonverbal cue to each person}
For this closed practice bank only:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \textbf{☀ $\to$ \pa{ਅਮਨ}}
  \item \textbf{★ $\to$ \pa{ਮਨਨ}}
\end{itemize}

Look for five seconds. Cover the Gurmukhi names. Point to the sun and recall its name; point to the star and recall its name. Uncover and compare.

\subsection*{Your turn — value selection}
With the bank visible, choose but do not copy: which value belongs to \textbf{★}? Which belongs to \textbf{☀}? The skill today is selecting the requested known value.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after the two-way contrast. No third name enters this field bank.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[nāṁ: Aman]{Fill one field with the bank visible}

\label{lesson:PA-W02-name-supported}



\begin{quote}
Read the label \textbf{\pa{ਨਾਂ}}. Recall the visible bank: \textbf{☀ \pa{ਅਮਨ} · ★ \pa{ਮਨਨ}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn — supported entry}
Keep the bank visible. The sun card requests its known value:

\begin{quote}
☀ \&nbsp;\&nbsp; \textbf{\pa{ਨਾਂ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

Select \textbf{\pa{ਅਮਨ}} and copy it on the line. Read the completed field from label to value. This is supported entry, not independent writing evidence.

\subsection*{Writing — separate spelling check}
Check only spelling: \textbf{\pa{ਅ} | \pa{ਮ} | \pa{ਨ}}. Do not check spacing or selection in this pass. If one piece differs, repair that one piece.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after one supported field.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[star cue: Manan]{Hide the bank, then fill one line}

\label{lesson:PA-W02-name-delayed}



\begin{quote}
Look once: \textbf{☀ \pa{ਅਮਨ} · ★ \pa{ਮਨਨ}}. Cover the complete bank and wait ten seconds.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — delayed requested entry}
Keep the bank hidden. Complete only this field:

\begin{quote}
★ \&nbsp;\&nbsp; \textbf{\pa{ਨਾਂ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

The requested value is chosen from memory; there is no copyable answer beside the line. Reveal the bank only after writing.

\subsection*{Your turn — separate repair passes}
Compare in order: (1) selected person, (2) three written positions, (3) any extra space inside the name. Repair the first differing dimension and stop.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
This is one delayed choice, not a six-field form.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[name field]{One no-model name field}

\label{lesson:PA-W02-name-no-model}



\begin{quote}
Close the previous lesson. Keep only the two learned identity symbols in memory. There is no value bank, support-language name, or romanized answer below.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — independent controlled choice}
Complete the requested field:

\begin{quote}
☀ \&nbsp;\&nbsp; \textbf{\pa{ਨਾਂ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

Choose the known value attached to the sun and write it from memory. Do not open an earlier lesson until the attempt is complete.

\subsection*{Your turn — separate repair passes}
After writing, compare in four bounded passes: requested person, spelling, spacing, then label/value placement. Repair only the first differing dimension.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
You have completed one field pattern. Five more field families remain before the published six-field form can be attempted.
\end{tcolorbox}
